title: 第574章 再战青狮底牌频出第573章 再次闭关北方异变
slug: 师弟你的丹药太不正经了
content_zh:
推荐各位书友阅读：师弟，你的丹药太不正经了正文第574章：再战青狮，底牌频出！（..la）降魔杵裹挟着金红色的佛光洪流。
如同一座被压缩到极致的小山。
朝着李玄的头顶轰然砸落！
那速度太快了，快到周围的空间。
都被挤压出一阵刺耳的音爆。
废墟地面上原本就松散的石块。
被这股劲风直接掀飞出去。
如同弹片般四散飞溅。
在残破的墙壁上打出无数道细密的裂纹。
李玄没有硬接。
他脚下一踏，身形如同被风卷起的落叶般。
向后飘退了数丈。
同时手中弓弦已经拉满。
一支由真龙骨碎屑磨制。
六丁神火附着其上的箭矢离弦而出。
直奔青毛狮王的右肩关节处。
那里是佛甲衔接的缝隙。
是肉眼可见的薄弱点。
“铛！”
青毛狮王甚至连躲都没躲。

那支箭矢精准地射中了。
他的右肩关节缝隙。
但只是发出了一声。
如同射在铁板上的清脆撞击声。
箭矢被崩飞出去。
在空中折成两段。
佛甲的防御力比他上次交手时又厚重了不少。
而且那种金红色的佛光。
似乎自带一层弹性的缓冲层。
能将集中一点的冲击力分散到更大的面积上。
“哼。”
青毛狮王冷哼一声。
降魔杵落空后在地面上。
砸出一个深坑。
他手腕一翻。
庞大的身躯竟然以一种。
与体型完全不符的敏捷度转了半圈。
杵尾横扫，带起一道扇形的金色佛光。
将正从侧面试图接近的冷月涵逼退了半步。
“皮又厚了！”

冷月涵侧身避过那道光波。
真龙法相在她身后猛然凝实。
暗金色的脊骨骨刺。
如同倒竖的刀林般。
content_en:
Recommended for all book friends to read: Junior brother, your elixir is too unorthodox Chapter 574 of the main text: Fighting the Green Lion again, the trump cards are frequently revealed! (..la) The demon-conquering pestle carries a torrent of golden-red Buddha light.
Like a hill compressed to the extreme.
It slammed down on Li Xuan's head!
The speed was so fast that it reached the surrounding space.
They were all squeezed out with a harsh sonic boom.
There were already loose stones on the ruins ground.
He was blown away directly by this strong wind.
Scattering like shrapnel.
Countless fine cracks were made on the broken wall.
Li Xuan did not force the answer.
He stepped on it and his figure was like a fallen leaf blown up by the wind.
Floated back several feet.
At the same time, the bowstring in his hand was fully drawn.
One was ground from scraps of real dragon bone.
The arrow attached to the Six Ding Divine Fire came out of the string.
Go straight to the right shoulder joint of the Green Hair Lion King.
There is the gap where the Buddha's armor connects.
It is a weak point visible to the naked eye.
"Cang!"
The Green-haired Lion King didn't even hide.
The arrow hit accurately.
A gap in his right shoulder joint.
But it just made a sound.
It sounded like a crisp impact on an iron plate.
The arrow flew out.
Fold into two pieces in the air.
Buddha Armor's defense was much thicker than the last time he fought.
And that kind of golden-red Buddha light.
It seems to have a flexible cushioning layer.
It can spread the concentrated impact force over a larger area.
"Hmph."
The Green-haired Lion King snorted coldly.
The Demon-Conquering Pestle is on the ground after it falls.
Make a deep hole.
He flipped his wrist.
The huge body turned out to be in a kind of way.
He turned half a circle with agility completely inconsistent with his size.
The tail of the pestle swept across, bringing up a fan-shaped golden Buddha light.
Leng Yuehan, who was trying to approach from the side, was forced back half a step.
"The skin is thick again!"
Leng Yuehan turned sideways to avoid the light wave.
The True Dragon Dharma Form suddenly solidified behind her.
Dark golden spine spurs.
Like a forest of upright knives.
